name: Chai Tea
siboNotes: Plain chai tea without milk is well-tolerated. Avoid chai lattes made with regular milk or honey sweeteners.
preparationTips: Brew with water only to keep FODMAP-free
Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of coconut milk if desired
Sweeten with maple syrup or sugar instead of honey
Steep for 3-5 minutes for optimal flavor extraction
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from black tea and spices
Provides warming spices like cinnamon and cardamom
